fields.name: Code
fields.description: The code a customer types. Uppercase by convention.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Internal description — what this coupon is for.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: ISO currency code. Only meaningful for a fixed discount.

fields.name: MinimumSubtotal
fields.description: Smallest order subtotal this coupon applies to. 0 or unset means no minimum.

fields.name: MaximumDiscount
fields.description: Caps a percentage discount. 0 or unset means no cap.

fields.name: StartsDate
fields.description: First moment the coupon is usable. Unset means immediately.

fields.name: ExpiresDate
fields.description: Last moment the coupon is usable. Unset means no expiry.

fields.name: UsageLimit
fields.description: Total redemptions allowed across all customers. 0 or unset means unlimited.

fields.name: UsageCount
fields.description: Redemptions so far. See the .md — this is not reliably enforceable.

fields.name: PerCustomerLimit
fields.description: Redemptions allowed per customer. Not enforced yet — see the .md.
